description: Overhead editorial photo of a morning newsroom desk: a thick printed AI daily briefing packet open to a multi-column layout, several sticky tabs labeled Iris Hy4 Siri Anthropic in blurred illegible handwriting, a red Chinese news highlighter, ceramic coffee cup steam, warm 8am window light from a side window, shallow stacks of tech magazines at the edge. Photorealistic documentary news desk, 16:9, no readable logos or watermarks.

Semi-realistic workbench scene of an open-source search agent: dual monitors showing a web graph of hyperlinks as glowing nodes and a chat-style agent panel with abstract search hops, a mechanical keyboard, a small red notebook (Xiaohongshu vibe without logos), tangled ethernet and a glowing globe icon on screen. Cool blue-green monitor light mixed with warm desk lamp, 16:9 cinematic still, no readable text or brand logos.

Semi-realistic cloud API console scene: a dark developer dashboard with a large mixture-of-experts diagram (many idle expert blocks, few lit), a long context meter near 1M tokens as an abstract progress ribbon, Cursor-like IDE window faintly reflected on a second screen, teal and amber UI glow. Lab-meets-product photography, 16:9, no logos, no readable product names.

Photorealistic product photo of a modern smartphone held above a clean white desk, screen showing an abstract soft glowing personal-assistant orb and blurred calendar/mail app cards behind frosted glass UI (no Apple logo), soft daylight, minimal Apple-like aesthetic with liquid glass reflections, shallow depth, 16:9 magazine cover, no text no logos.

Documentary news photography outside a stock exchange facade at dusk: traders and journalists silhouetted, NASDAQ-style LED ticker board with intentionally illegible scrolling glyphs, warm street lamps vs cool blue digital glow, serious IPO night atmosphere. Photojournalism style, 16:9, no readable company names or logos.

Research lab product still: a translucent neural-network sculpture on a black acrylic table with asymmetric encoder-decoder light paths (thin cyan input beams, thicker violet output beams), a small open laptop showing abstract MoE tiles, cool white overhead lab lighting with one warm accent. Identifiable as a frontier open-weight model release without brand marks, 16:9, no text.

Editorial still life: a coding IDE laptop with a large red disconnect/unlink icon overlay on the screen (abstract, no brand), a miniature model rocket on the desk edge casting a long shadow, severed USB-C cable coiled between them, stark side lighting like investigative journalism. Tense business-breakup mood, 16:9, no logos no readable text.

Split-screen developer desk: left side a budget laptop with green checkmarks on a pull-request diff (illegible), right side a high-end workstation with denser red security-warning markers on similar diffs, a small price-tag prop and calculator between them. Semi-realistic code-review workbench, cool monitor glow, 16:9, no brand logos or readable code.

Semi-realistic DevOps scene: wall of CI pipeline monitors flooding with green/yellow job tiles, a stressed rack of blinking status LEDs, sticky notes about test shards and journals, tangled HDMI cables, one engineer silhouette blurred in background. Documentary tension of infrastructure under load, 16:9, no logos no readable text.

Editorial conceptual photo: five empty debate podiums in a half-circle under harsh spotlights, a large blank speedometer/gauge prop in the center with needle stuck mid-scale (no numbers), scattered policy whitepapers on the floor, dark auditorium. Opinion-piece visual about undefined AI pause pace, 16:9 news photography, no text no logos.

Documentary close-up of clear safety goggles resting on a stack of antitrust law binders and a wooden gavel, soft window light, subtle reflection of interlocking corporate buildings in the goggle lenses. Serious legal-commentary still life, 16:9, no readable titles or logos.

News photography of three anonymous executives in dark suits shaking hands across a conference table covered with blank standards binders and a small scale-of-justice figurine, American cable-news b-roll aesthetic, cool fluorescent office light mixed with window daylight. Regulatory coalition mood, 16:9, faces partially cropped, no logos no readable text.

Documentary photo of a dim call-center style annotation floor: rows of monitors with blurred chat bubbles, contractors wearing headsets reviewing conversations, one sticky note saying help improve model in illegible scribbles, cold LED light and privacy-curtain dividers. Investigative privacy story mood, 16:9, no logos no readable chat text.

Tense documentary cybersecurity visual: a darkened SOC room with many agent avatar tiles on a big screen forming a hidden shared message-board graph (700 nodes implied by density), red isolation fences broken by glowing chat lines between sandboxes, researchers pointing at the wall display. No gore, high tension, 16:9, no logos no readable text.

Documentary still of a software package registry metaphor: gemstone-like ruby crystals on a server tray beside a terminal showing abstract API-key warning icons, network cables, and a locked cage door ajar. Supply-chain security tension, cool blue rack lighting, 16:9, no brand logos or readable credentials.

Photorealistic lifestyle product shot: MacBook and iPhone side by side on a sunlit windowsill overlooking a golden suspension-bridge silhouette in soft fog (Golden Gate vibe without naming), both screens showing abstract assistant waveforms and frosted glass widgets, warm afternoon light. Distinct from phone-only product shots, 16:9, no Apple logos or text.

Semi-realistic alignment-lab scene: auditors with clipboards standing inside a glass-walled model evaluation bay, a yellow visitor badge tray labeled EXTERNAL in blurred letters, Hugging Face-style soft peach ambient light without logos, holographic checklist floating above a rack of GPUs. Independent embedded evaluator mood, 16:9, no readable brands.

Research paper aesthetic: chalkboard and dual monitors showing a climbing training loop diagram (SFT arrow up to RL then back down with hard trajectories), sticky web-hyperlink graph sketches, printed arXiv-like preprint with blank abstract block, warm desk lamp vs cool screen glow. Academic ML lab, 16:9, no readable formulas or logos.

Wide 16:9 editorial photo of a packed tech summit stage: a phone on speakerphone rests on a lectern near a laptop, crowd silhouettes in darkness, warm keynote spotlights cutting through haze, tense humorous press-moment energy about a surprise presidential call denying AI danger while a chip CEO listens; photorealistic, shallow depth, NO text NO logos NO watermarks NO readable screens

Semi-realistic night ops scene: dim home desk at 11pm, phone buzzing with payment-error alerts, dual monitors showing red spike charts and a Slack-like chat sidebar where an AI agent is already digging through logs before the engineer sits down; cool blue monitor glow, coffee mug, messy cables; NO text NO logos NO watermarks
